title: Lost
body:
Lost all reminders after new update
It came up to delete all and I thought it was the reminders finished with. 
Not a userfrienly option that popped up by itself. Don’t know how to backup or retrieve a backup.
author: Ketielie

title: Best Reminder app
body: Due is the only practical reminder app on my iphone. Easy and reliable to use. I use it daily over the past year. What a pleasure!
author: Hipsterpe

title: Just Brilliant
body: Perhaps my most used and most hated app. The constant reminders are annoying and lifesaving and infuriating and brilliant. I could not survive without them. I do wish there was a quicker way to access the timers. Having to open the side menu to switch between the two screens is annoying. It would be more useful to have buttons in the header/banner that allow faster switching.
author: ladyjane_

title: The best app to help you manage your time
body: I have tried other apps in the past but Due is by far the best to help you manage your day to day activities, your future to do lists, whilst setting your mind at ease. Highly recommended!!
author: missvan58

title: Awesome App.
body: Love the UI, love the aesthetics, love the navigation, packed with a lot of features. I’m never forgetting anything with the app. Absolutely worth the penny!
author: Mtedafy

title: Fantastic
body:
This application outshines even the stock reminders in iOS. I will never be without it as it is essential for me to manage my reminders.

Just set it and forget it. It will keep on reminding you until you respond.
author: DirkStrauss

title: Simple and effective
body: Works very well, easy to use, never forget anything again!
author: Cor1001

title: Great reminder app
body: I've always only used iOS reminders, as I haven't yet found anything that works for me. But Due is finally the one. It works so well. Would give it 5 stars if it could incorporate force touch, as I find myself force pressing on the reminders to make changes. Love this app.
author: HappyPiglet

title: Very Useful Utility
body: Since I installed the app, it's become one of my most used apps. Very useful!
author: Rol&Hill

title: Not working properly
body:
I have used the app for over two years with no negative issues...until recently. Now, my reminders will either not 'remind' at all, or if they do, they set off the alarm once...and never again. If I ignore the first alarm (always presuming I even get one!) I don't get a second reminder and the task does not get done.

I have updated both IOS and the Due software and there is no improvement.
author: WobblyWilly
